PH ASIN Segmentation
Growth Protection Engine · UK Amazon FBM · category-wise benchmarks

Select a Portfolio Holder

Pick a name to see that portfolio only — segments, movement and benchmarks in one view.

Segment mix — where each ASIN stands now · click to filter the table

Movement — how each ASIN changed vs last window · NEW = first time seen (nothing to compare yet)

Category benchmark — click a category row to see only its ranking · top-30 best-sellers per category (units-sold ranked); CVR = average of each product's conversion rate

ASIN-level view

Status vs the category's top-N average conversions: ABOVE ≥ avg×1.10 · NEAR ±10% · BELOW ≤ avg×0.90 · NEEDS REVIEW = data-quality flag (conversions > clicks, CVR > 100%, or conversions with zero clicks). Segment & Movement remain our engine's classification.
description: Monthly PH ASIN segmentation report (UK Amazon FBM). Poovitha, 6 segments, category-wise benchmarks, movement vs previous 4-week window, escalation flags. Window: last 4 complete weeks (31 May–27 Jun 2026). Movement fixed to equal 4-week windows. Rebuilt 1 Jul 2026.
